segments.an5.293:1.1: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato ājīvako yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segments.an5.293:1.3: Pāṇātipātī hoti, adinnādāyī hoti, abrahmacārī hoti, musāvādī hoti, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī hoti.
segments.an5.293:1.4: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato ājīvako yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye”ti.

lines: Etesaṃ pana sīlesu paripūrakāritāya abhāvena sukkapakkho na gahito.
Pattaggāhāpakoti “yo ca tassā bhikkhuparisāya pattapariyanto, so tassa bhikkhuno padātabbo”ti ettha vuttapattaggāhāpako.
